heading: EPFO Form 10C: Claiming Pension Benefits Explained
tldr: EPFO Form 10C is used to withdraw your Employees' Pension Scheme (EPS) contributions or to obtain a Scheme Certificate.
You can apply for a Scheme Certificate if you have completed at least 10 years of service but are not yet 58, to carry forward your pensionable service.
Withdrawal of EPS accumulations is possible if you have less than 10 years of service and are leaving employment before age 58.
The online application process requires an activated UAN, linked Aadhaar, and KYC-verified bank details.
Claiming EPS benefits through Form 10C is a crucial step for many employees transitioning between jobs or exiting the workforce.
caption:
Thinking about your future pension? 🤔 If you've changed jobs or are planning to, understanding your EPF pension is key. Form 10C helps you either move your pension contributions or withdraw them if you have less than 10 years of service. This is super important for securing your financial future. Learn how it works and what you need to do in our full article.
